# Disease Eradication Plan

> Academic research project proposing the 1% Treaty: redirecting 1% of global military spending to pragmatic clinical trials. Contains peer-reviewed analyses, governance frameworks, and implementation strategies.

This project consists of multiple interconnected research papers on health economics, regulatory reform, and democratic governance. All content is licensed under CC BY-NC 4.0.

## Core Concepts

- **1% Treaty**: International agreement to redirect 1% of military budgets to health research
- **dFDA**: Framework for automated drug assessment using real-world evidence
- **Predictor Impact Score**: Novel metric for causal inference from observational health data

## Research Papers

- [The 1% Treaty: Harnessing Greed to Eradicate Disease](https://manual.warondisease.org/knowledge/economics/1-pct-treaty-impact.html): 6.65 thousand diseases have zero FDA-approved treatments; at current trial capacity, exploring them takes ~443 years. Redirecting 1% of military spending scales capacity 12.3x, cutting the timeline to ~36 years and preventing 10.7 billion deaths. At $0.00177/DALY, 50.3kx more cost-effective than the best existing interventions. Incentive Alignment Bonds make adoption politically viable.
- [The 1% Treaty](https://manual.warondisease.org/knowledge/solution/1-percent-treaty.html): Your governments possess nuclear weapons sufficient to end civilization 122 times but have not cured Alzheimer's once. This treaty asks them to be 1% more rational.
- [Algorithmic Public Administration: A Protocol for Replacing Government Intermediaries with Deterministic Functions](https://manual.warondisease.org/knowledge/appendix/algorithmic-public-administration.html): A protocol combining five primitives (transparent ledger, preference aggregation, evidence engine, identity verification, automated monetary policy) to replace mechanical government agency functions, eliminating administrative intermediation costs while preserving democratic control.
- [How Much Does It Cost to Buy All the Governments?](https://manual.warondisease.org/knowledge/appendix/cost-of-change-analysis.html): What's the maximum cost to achieve any policy change through legal democratic channels? $25B for the US, $200B globally. For high-value reforms like military-to-health reallocation, this yields ROI exceeding 400,000:1.
- [The Court of Humanity](https://manual.warondisease.org/knowledge/appendix/court-of-humanity-paper.html): A decentralized court where 8 billion humans are the jury, sovereign immunity is a choice nobody chose, and ~$104 quadrillion in unliquidated wrongful-death exposure makes the 1% Treaty the most generous settlement offer in legal history.
- [Ubiquitous Pragmatic Trial Impact Analysis: How to Prevent a Year of Death and Suffering for 84 Cents](https://manual.warondisease.org/knowledge/appendix/dfda-impact-paper.html): Only 15 diseases/year get their first treatment each year. With 6.65 thousand diseases lacking effective treatments, the backlog would take 443 years to clear. Integrating pragmatic trials into standard healthcare increases trial capacity 12.3x, cutting that timeline from 443 years to 36 years. The average untreated disease gets a treatment 212 years earlier, saving 10.7 billion deaths at $0.842 per year of healthy life saved.
- [The Continuous Evidence Generation Protocol: Two-Stage Validation (RWE → Pragmatic Trials)](https://manual.warondisease.org/knowledge/appendix/dfda-spec-paper.html): We present the Predictor Impact Score (PIS), a novel composite metric operationalizing Bradford Hill causality criteria for automated signal detection from aggregated N-of-1 observational studies. Combined with pragmatic trial confirmation (based on evidence from 108+ embedded trials), this two-stage framework would generate validated outcome labels at 44.1x lower cost than traditional Phase III trials. This enables continuous, population-scale pharmacovigilance and precision dosing recommendations.
- [Drug Development Cost Increase Analysis](https://manual.warondisease.org/knowledge/appendix/drug-development-cost-analysis.html): Rigorous analysis of the 105x increase in drug development costs from pre-1962 to 2024, using Baily (1972) academic study with CPI adjustments and sensitivity analysis
- [Earth Optimization Prize Protocol: Technical Specification](https://manual.warondisease.org/knowledge/appendix/earth-optimization-prize-protocol.html): Technical specification for interoperable outcome prize pools structured as a dominant assurance contract. Covers cross-pool proof-of-personhood, a permissionless pool registry, VOTE and PRIZE token mechanics, direct cross-pool claims, tamper-evident scoreboard aggregation, and a terminal general-welfare metric oracle including decentralized surveys.
- [The Earth Optimization Prize](https://manual.warondisease.org/knowledge/strategy/earth-optimization-prize.html): Reward humanity for raising healthy life years and median income within 15 years. PRIZE keeps depositors on the failure branch, VOTE rewards recruiters on the success branch, and Earth Optimization Protocol v1 is only the current instruction manual for trying to win.
- [Choose Your Own Earth: A World Without the Political Dysfunction Tax, or Terminal Parasitic Load in 15 Years](https://manual.warondisease.org/knowledge/economics/gdp-trajectories.html): Your destructive economy (military spending plus cybercrime) is already 11.5% of GDP and growing faster than your productive economy. At current rates, it reaches the Soviet collapse threshold in 8 years and exceeds productive output in 15. This paper models two GDP trajectories: the optimized path under military-to-medical reallocation, and the default path to civilizational collapse.
- [The People of Earth v. Their Governments](https://manual.warondisease.org/knowledge/appendix/humanity-v-government.html): An indictment for negligent mass homicide separating historical body counts from forward-looking treaty-settlement exposure, with a 1% military reallocation as the only remedy commensurate with the offense.
- [Incentive Alignment Bonds: Making Public Goods Financially and Politically Profitable](https://manual.warondisease.org/knowledge/appendix/incentive-alignment-bonds-paper.html): Government spending is optimized for lobbying intensity, not net societal value. Programs with 100:1 benefit-cost ratios get billions while programs with negative returns get hundreds of billions. Incentive Alignment Bonds flip this by creating a capital pool that rewards politicians (via campaign support and post-office opportunities) for funding high-NSV programs over low-NSV alternatives. The result: public good becomes private profit for both investors and elected officials.
- [The Invisible Graveyard: Quantifying the Mortality Cost of FDA Efficacy Lag](https://manual.warondisease.org/knowledge/appendix/invisible-graveyard.html): After proving a drug is safe, the FDA requires 8.2 years to prove it works before patients can access it. We estimate this delay cost 102 million deaths among people waiting for approved drugs (1962-2024). The human cost in death and disability of blocking good drugs is 3.07k higher than the cost of approving bad ones.
- [How to End War and Disease](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org): The Complete Idiot's Guide to Legally Bribing Your Way to Utopia
- [How to End War and Disease](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org): The Complete Idiot's Guide to Legally Bribing Your Way to Utopia
- [The Optimal Budget Generator: A Causal Inference Protocol for Maximizing Median Health and Wealth Through Public Goods Funding](https://manual.warondisease.org/knowledge/appendix/optimal-budget-generator-spec.html): The Optimal Budget Generator (OBG) uses causal inference, diminishing returns modeling, and cost-effectiveness evidence to determine optimal public goods funding levels that maximize two welfare metrics: real after-tax median income growth and median healthy life years. For each spending category, OBG estimates an Optimal Spending Level (OSL) and produces a gap analysis showing where current government budgets are over- or underfunded relative to evidence-based benchmarks. The Budget Impact Score (BIS) measures confidence in each recommendation based on the quality of causal evidence.
- [The Optimal Policy Generator: A Causal Inference Protocol for Maximizing Median Health and Wealth Through Public Policy](https://manual.warondisease.org/knowledge/appendix/optimal-policy-generator-spec.html): The Optimal Policy Generator (OPG) produces systematic public policy recommendations for jurisdictions at any level (country, state, city), generating prioritized enact/replace/repeal/maintain recommendations to maximize real after-tax median income growth and median healthy life years, based on quasi-experimental evidence from centuries of policy variation data.
- [Optimocracy: Causal Inference on Cross-Jurisdictional Policy Data to Maximize Median Health and Wealth](https://manual.warondisease.org/knowledge/appendix/optimocracy-paper.html): Thousands of jurisdictions have made different policy and budget choices over decades, creating a natural experiment. Optimocracy applies causal inference to this cross-jurisdictional time-series data to identify which policies predict above-average median income and healthy life years. It then publishes evidence-based recommendations for every major vote, tracks politician alignment, and funds aligned candidates via SuperPAC, making suboptimal policy politically expensive while preserving democratic structures.
- [The Organized Violence Tax](https://manual.warondisease.org/knowledge/problem/cost-of-war.html): Quantifying the compound cost of war since 1900: 310 million dead, $1.48 quadrillion in historical costs, and a 23x income multiple lost to eight compounding channels of destruction.
- [The Political Dysfunction Tax](https://manual.warondisease.org/knowledge/appendix/political-dysfunction-tax.html): Quantifying the gap between current global governance and theoretical maximum welfare, estimating a 31-53% efficiency score and $97 trillion in annual opportunity costs.
- [Right to Trial & FDA Upgrade Act](https://manual.warondisease.org/knowledge/appendix/right-to-trial-fda-upgrade-act.html): Act to modernize medical research and treatment access through an open-source FDA.gov v2, giving patients the right to participate in trials.
- [United States Efficiency Audit](https://manual.warondisease.org/knowledge/appendix/us-efficiency-audit.html): Systems audit estimating an annual U.S. efficiency gap of $4.9T, with $2.45T recoverable at OECD-median performance across direct spending waste, compliance burden, policy-induced GDP loss, and system inefficiency.
- [Wishocracy: Solving the Democratic Principal-Agent Problem Through Pairwise Preference Aggregation](https://manual.warondisease.org/knowledge/appendix/wishocracy-paper.html): Representative democracy suffers from an inescapable principal-agent problem where elected officials' incentives diverge from citizen welfare. Wishocracy introduces RAPPA (Randomized Aggregated Pairwise Preference Allocation), which aggregates citizen preferences through cognitively tractable pairwise comparisons and creates accountability via Citizen Alignment Scores that channel electoral resources toward politicians who actually represent what citizens want.
- [Wishonia's Wager: Any Finite Action Is Rational When the Stakes Are Infinite](https://manual.warondisease.org/knowledge/proof/wishonias-wager.html): A reconstruction of Pascal's Wager with its defects removed. Two propositions cannot be disproven: that a conscious being may suffer without end, and that it may flourish without end. Both carry nonzero probability and infinite magnitude, so any finite action that shifts probability from the first toward the second has unbounded expected value. Unlike Pascal's, the wagered action is empirical, not theological: funding the clinical trials that extend healthy lifespan and modify conscious experience.

## Book: How to End War and Disease

### Start Here

- [index.qmd](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/index.html)
- [Select Your Preferred Sensory Input Channel](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/links.html): Humans require instructions delivered through specific orifices. Choose yours. Available via skull vibration ports, murdered trees, or glowing rectangles.
- [Skull Auditory Port Edition](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/podcast.html): Step-by-step instructions for bribing humanity into not murdering you, narrated directly into your head. Free on every app that puts sounds in your skull auditory ports.
- [Wishonia's Wager](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/proof/wishonias-wager.html): You cannot prove you won't suffer forever. You cannot prove you won't be pleasant forever. Both probabilities are greater than zero, both outcomes are infinite, and the cost of nudging the odds is one share of a military contractor. When the stakes are infinite, any finite action is rational. It is Pascal's Wager with the bugs fixed.
- [What Matters](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/proof/what-matters.html): The target is not GDP, votes, points, or money. The target is conscious experience. Everything else is instrumentation.

### Failure Analysis

- [Diagnostic Summary](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/problem.html): A diagnostic survey of the systems that allocate your species' resources to killing instead of curing
- [The Cost of War](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/problem/cost-of-war.html): Since 1900, your governments printed [value] out of nothing and spent it murdering [value] and destroying many valuable things those people spent their entire lives building. If you had required donations to fund all wars since 1900 and outlawed funding them through printing money, none of this death and destruction would have happened and you would be [value] richer today from the compound effects of productive instead of destructive spending.
- [The Cost of Disease](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/problem/cost-of-disease.html): The annual bill for letting your bodies fall apart. It's more than all the money on Earth, which is impressive in a terrible way.
- [NIH Fails to Institute Health](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/problem/nih-fails-2-institute-health.html): A root cause failure analysis to show why the world's largest medical research institution only allocates 3.3% of its budget to testing which of the thousands of known-safe treatments actually work in humans. Oxford tested COVID treatments for $500 per patient and saved a million lives in 100 days. The NIH spent $1.6 billion and completed zero trials in four years.
- [The Untapped Therapeutic Frontier](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/problem/untapped-therapeutic-frontier.html): There are 9.5 million possible drug-disease combinations. You've tested 32,500. That's like searching for your keys in 0.34% of your house and declaring them lost. The other 99.7% is sitting right there, untested, because the molecules weren't profitable enough to bother.
- [Your FDA Is Unsafe and Ineffective](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/problem/fda-is-unsafe-and-ineffective.html): A drug passes every safety test your species invented. It won't hurt you. Everyone agrees. You still can't have it for another [value]. There is, however, no waiting list for dying. No one blocks that. The testing costs [value] more than proven alternatives and excludes [value] of the patients who'll actually take it. For every 1 unit of harm prevented, the system creates [value] through denied access. Here's how to fix it.
- [Unrepresentative Democracy](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/problem/unrepresentative-democracy.html): Your government spends 604 times more on weapons than on testing which medicines work. You could elect 535 Gandhis and within two years they'd be funding nuclear weapons programs, because the system requires it. Princeton studied 1,779 of your policy decisions and found that public opinion has the same effect on legislation as a houseplant. This chapter explains why you can't vote your way out, and why that's actually fine, because the solution was never better politicians.
- [Money Comes From a Building and They Use It to Kill People](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/economics/central-banks.html): Your money is manufactured in a building by people you didn't elect. It has funded unpopular wars that killed [value] people. They give it to their friends first, then use the rest to buy weapons you didn't ask for. By the time it reaches you, it buys less. This has been happening for a century. Nobody covers it on the news because it is, by design, extremely boring.
- [Genetic Slavery](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/problem/genetic-slavery.html): Your government spends [value] more on weapons than on curing disease, and you think that's a political problem. It's not. It's a hardware problem. You're running 200,000-year-old software optimized for hoarding rocks and fearing strangers, and you've given it nuclear weapons. This chapter is the owner's manual for the brain that's trying to kill you.
- [I Am Retarded](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/problem/i-am-retarded.html): There is no line between smart people and the other kind. There is a ladder, from snails up to perfect knowledge, rationality, and logic, and every human who ever lived (the geniuses, the presidents, all of us) is bunched together near the bottom of it, squinting up. Which means a large fraction of what we believe, what we voted for, and what we are angry about is probably wrong.

### System Optimization

- [Optimization Summary](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/solution.html): Optimized replacements for the systems identified in the failure analysis
- [The 1% Treaty](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/solution/1-percent-treaty.html): Your governments possess nuclear weapons sufficient to end civilization [value] times but have not cured Alzheimer's once. This treaty requires them to be 1% more rational.
- [The Court of Humanity](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/solution/court-of-humanity.html): A court where any human can sue any government, sovereign immunity is not a defense, and the 1% Treaty is the settlement offer.
- [Decentralized Institutes of Health](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/solution/dih.html): Your military-industrial complex solved coordination for killing: weapons manufacturers, generals, politicians, and factory workers all profit from the same budget, so they all show up. Disease has no such coalition. Your Decentralized Institutes of Health builds one. It does three things: receive treaty funds, allocate them via patient choice and wishocratic voting, and pay based on results instead of grant applications. It's SHAEF for the war on disease. Same selfishness as the military-industrial complex, but pointed at biology instead of each other. Nobody gets paid for writing essays about why they should be allowed to try curing things. They get paid for curing things.
- [Wishocracy](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/solution/wishocracy.html): How to let billions of people say whether the next marginal public dollar should buy another nuclear weapon system or fund another pragmatic clinical trial, without routing the answer through lobbyists, committees, and middlemen.
- [A Decentralized FDA](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/solution/dfda.html): You type in what's wrong with you, see what worked for everyone else, and try it. The outcomes get recorded automatically. We've had this for millennia. Your decentralized FDA is the same thing, built with technology you already have. It's an open protocol that connects treatments to patients, records what actually happens, and publishes the results. Consumer Reports, but for not dying. It cuts trial costs from [value] to [value], expands capacity from [value] to [value], and replaces your 40-page drug inserts with Outcome Labels that tell you what actually happened to real humans who took the pill.
- [Aligning Incentives](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/solution/aligning-incentives.html): Pharmaceutical companies make more money treating you forever than curing you once. Military contractors earn $1,425 per lobbying dollar. Nobody is evil. The incentives are. Rearrange the profit motive so curing disease pays better than causing it, and watch capitalism accidentally save your species.
- [Incentive Alignment Bonds](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/solution/incentive-alignment-bonds.html): War bonds, but backwards. Your grandparents funded WW2 at roughly 3% returns. You fund disease eradication at 272%. Same structure, fewer Nazis, better spreadsheet.
- [Earth Optimization Services](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/solution/earth-optimization-services.html): Universe Optimization Services has helped over 300 civilizations upgrade from 'actively self-destructing' to 'surprisingly pleasant.' Earth is now accepting applications.
- [Theory of Operation](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/solution/theory-of-operation.html): Civilization is a machine with a job: increase pleasant conscious experience and reduce unpleasant conscious experience. HALE and median income are the terminal general-welfare metrics. Here is the schematic, the way a repair manual draws one, so you can see which part failed.
- [Special Education](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/solution/special-education.html): Earth Optimization Services' free, AI-tutored special education. It teaches you the manual to the level your job needs. Called special education because everyone needs it, including you, including me.
- [Optimocracy: The Evidence Machine](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/solution/optimocracy.html): The Optimitron comes free with your first government. Its Optimal Budget Generator (OBG) and Optimal Policy Generator (OPG) check which policies work by looking at the 10,000 places that already tried them. Your species skipped this step and went straight to arguing.
- [How to Not Build Most of It](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/open-ecosystem-and-bounty-model.html): A dFDA strategy for getting other people to build everything through open APIs and bounties, like WordPress but for not dying.

### Your Government, Debugged

- [Department of Peace](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/solution/department-of-peace.html): War is a negative-sum game and the spreadsheet agrees. Wishonia's replacement for the Department of Defense requires zero lines of code.
- [The Automated Revenue Service](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/solution/automated-revenue-service.html): 74,000 pages of tax code replaced by six lines of code. The IRS employs 83,000 humans to do what a smart contract does automatically.
- [The Universal Security Administration](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/solution/universal-security-administration.html): You spend more administering help than you spend helping. 80+ welfare programs replaced by one for-loop.
- [The Aligned Election Commission](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/solution/aligned-election-commission.html): Your politicians are funded by the people they're supposed to regulate. Wishonia replaces campaign finance with a single alignment score.
- [The Decentralized Accountability Office](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/solution/decentralized-accountability-office.html): You pay 3,400 humans to audit a ledger that could audit itself. Then you wait eighteen months for the results.
- [The Decentralized Census Bureau](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/solution/decentralized-census-bureau.html): You spend fourteen billion dollars to count everyone once every ten years. citizenCount() returns in fifty milliseconds.

### For Skeptics

- [The Proof: Overview](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/proof.html): This Already Works - Pragmatic trials prove [value] efficiency. History proves every component. Switzerland, war bonds, landmines, the 3.5% rule, and Wall Street's craziest bets all prove humans can accidentally do smart things when properly motivated.
- [They Cut the Bomb Budget 87% and Everyone Got Richer](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/proof/bomb-budget-cut.html): After World War 2, they cut the bomb budget [value] and walked into the largest rise in living standards in history. Then they put it back. Here is what happened.
- [There Are No Bad Guys (That Is the Problem)](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/proof/no-bad-guys.html): Nobody designed a world that spends 604 dollars on war for every dollar on clinical trials. Four mechanisms produced it without anyone deciding to. That is worse than a conspiracy, because there are no bad guys to remove.
- [The Biotechnological Imperative](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/proof/biotechnological-imperative.html): Kant's categorical imperative applied to biotech funding. You cannot universalize 'spend money on killing instead of curing.' Therefore redirecting military spending to clinical trials is not optional. It is a categorical duty.
- [You Are a Meat Robot](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/proof/body-as-repairable-machine.html): The usual objection to curing all disease is that it's impossible. You replace 330 billion cells a day. You 3D-print windpipes. You reprogram skin into brain cells. You've already proven your body is a machine, and machines are repairable. The only reason you haven't repaired it is that you spent the repair budget on missiles. This chapter removes the "impossible" objection so you can get back to the "expensive" objection, which the treaty solves.
- [Why Hasn't Anyone Done This?](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/proof/why-hasnt-anyone-done-this.html): People have. Many times. Sachs, the WHO, the Copenhagen Consensus, Nobel laureates. They all stalled for the same reason: no self-sustaining financial mechanism. The math was never the missing piece. The engine was.
- [The Delusion of Insignificance](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/proof/delusion-of-insignificance.html): You are the entire universe from the only perspective you will ever have. The universe is telling itself it is too small to matter. That is the delusion.
- [Your Personal Benefits](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/call-to-action/your-personal-benefits.html): How much money you personally lose if civilization continues optimizing for murder instead of medicine, and what happens to your bank account if it stops. Includes a calculator for the selfishly rational.
- [The Two Futures](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/futures.html): Two timelines diverge from this moment. One ends in extinction, the other in transcendence. The only difference is a 1% budget reallocation.
- [The Cautionary Tale of Moronia](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/futures/moronia.html): A planet had every tool needed to cure disease and chose to build weapons instead. They went extinct. Their last words were 'but the economy.' This is a bedtime story for civilizations that can't do math.
- [Wishonia](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/futures/wishonia.html): On one planet, citizens allocate the budget directly, lobbyists don't exist, and disease was eradicated 4,000 years ago. It uses the same technology you have. The difference is they pointed it at biology instead of each other.
- [Frequently Asked Objections](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/faq.html): Fun facts for those reasonably skeptical of spending 1% more on helping sick people than killing them.
- [Where Am I Wrong?](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/where-am-i-wrong.html): The full argument for the 1% treaty in one breath, including the shareholder-lawsuit mechanism for getting it into the brains of military contractors.

### For Institutions

- [The Initiating Node Memo](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/strategy/initiating-node-memo.html): A sponsor-facing memo for institutions considering whether to host the first 90-day Earth Optimization Prize pilot. The host role is to convene, publish, seed, and measure without becoming the mechanism's sovereign.
- [Earth Optimization Prize 90-Day Pilot](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/grant-proposal/earth-optimization-prize-90-day-pilot.html): A sponsor-facing 90-day pilot proposal for institutions considering whether to host the first Earth Optimization Prize launch without becoming the mechanism's root of trust.
- [Voter Acquisition Grant Proposal](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/grant-proposal/voter-acquisition-grant.html): A grant proposal template for funding a coordinator that aggregates existing nonprofit Google Ad Grants, iframe embeds, and communication channels into the largest public referendum on disease eradication ever conducted. Funding tiers scale from $100K Year 1 to $50M by Year 5. Per-voter cost-effectiveness beats every existing global health intervention by orders of magnitude.
- [Institution Outreach Email Templates](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/strategy/institution-outreach-email.html): Reusable outreach email templates for institutions considering whether to host the first Earth Optimization Prize pilot.

### The Plan

- [The Most Important Secret in the World: 20 Questions to End War and Disease](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/strategy/questions.html): A call script for the someone you love. Ask them 20 questions. Get them to ask 2 more people. If the average person asks 2, this reaches 4 billion humans in 32 rounds.
- [Declaration of Optimization](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/strategy/declaration-of-optimization.html): The purpose of government is to promote the general welfare, measured by the median healthy life years and median after-tax inflation-adjusted income of its citizens. This document is a polite request that they do so.
- [Earth Optimization Protocol v1](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/strategy/earth-optimization-protocol-v1.html): Humans are the contestants in the Earth Optimization Prize. This paper documents the current open-source instruction manual for helping humanity raise healthy life years and median income by [value]. Fork it and improve it to help humanity win faster.
- [How to Coordinate 10 Million Nonprofits](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/strategy/nonprofit-coalition-strategy.html): Your species has roughly 10 million nonprofits and cannot cure Alzheimer's. This chapter explains why, then supplies the exact emails, legal memo, and four-stage activation funnel for fixing it.
- [Pre-Built Google Ads Campaign for Coalition Partners](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/google-ads-campaign-template.html): A ready-to-load Google Ads campaign template for nonprofit partners running the 1% Treaty voter-acquisition channel through their existing Google Ad Grant.
- [Legal Architecture](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/legal/legal-framework.html): Bribing politicians is illegal unless you call it 'lobbying' or 'campaign contributions.' Then it's protected speech. Here's the legal architecture for saving humanity using your own ridiculous laws.
- [Election Law](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/legal/election-law.html): How to Buy Politicians Legally
- [The Legislation Package](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/strategy/legislation-package.html): Lobbyists write bills and give them to politicians who can't read. You're about to become the best lobbyist in history, except your bills actually help people instead of killing them.
- [Global Referendum Strategy](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/strategy/global-referendum.html): Humanity downloaded TikTok over 4 billion times to watch strangers twerk. Getting [value] verified people to click 'yes' on not dying should be easier. Here's how, with math.
- [Building Your AI Coordination Army](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/solution/ai-coordination-army.html): Humans evolved to coordinate hunting parties of 20. You need to coordinate millions. Your brains literally can't do it. Robots can.
- [Treaty Feasibility & Cost Analysis](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/treaty-feasibility.html): Previous treaties failed because they ran on guilt. Guilt has terrible fuel efficiency. This one runs on greed, which is (regrettably) humanity's only reliable fuel source.
- [Recruitment & Propaganda Plan](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/recruitment-and-propaganda-plan.html): You want to end war and disease but don't have a nonprofit, a bank account, or anything to offer anyone. Here's how to recruit 100,000 humans before you have anything except an argument. It's a Kickstarter where the reward tier is 'possibly not dying,' which is the most compelling crowdfunding offer in history.
- [Getting Started](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/strategy/getting-started.html): A first-ninety-days roadmap for anyone running the treaty campaign with a nonprofit, a website with the voting widget, and the book. Assumes no money, no staff, and no time. Most of the work fits in four focused hours a day.
- [How to End War and Disease](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/educational-film.html): Your orientation film. 1950s educational film style, 3 minutes, producible with AI for the budget of a medium wedding.
- [Distribution Checklist](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/strategy/distribution-checklist.html): A systematic checklist for repurposing the book and its arguments into platform-native formats across Medium, Substack, LinkedIn, X, Bluesky, Reddit, Hacker News, and short-form video. The book exists. The job left is putting it in front of humans on the channels they already visit.
- [The Decentralized To-Do List for Humanity](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/strategy/humanity-todo-list.html): A public accountability primitive. Named individuals and institutions are assigned specific tasks (sign the treaty, embed the widget, fund the prize pool). A live death-counter runs next to every unfulfilled task. Anonymous inaction becomes named inaction, priced in humans per day.
- [Earth Optimization Day](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/strategy/earth-optimization-day.html): An annual coordinated global action day, and the built-in ratchet event where the 1% Treaty percentage moves up by another percent every year. The day humanity gets 1% less irrational. Partner nonprofits, foundations, and platforms deploy their embeds, ad spend, and communications on the same date. Media gets an event, not ongoing activity. The public gets a Schelling point. Every year, the wave gets larger and the redirect gets bigger.
- [The Planetary Constitutional Convention](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/strategy/planetary-constitutional-convention.html): The Planetary Constitutional Convention is a deliberative process to stress-test and improve the current Earth Optimization instruction manual. Revisions must cover ten required governance functions, pass eleven constitutional constraints, and survive public adversarial review. The ratified revision becomes the current manual.
- [Conclusion](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/conclusion.html)

### Earth Optimization Commission

- [Earth Optimization Commission](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/strategy/earth-optimization-commission.html): Every commissioner is appointed President of Earth Optimization Services on camera, given two metrics, and asked what they would do first. Each one inaugurates at least two successors. A binary tree reaches 8 billion in 33 generations.
- [The Funniest Show in the Universe](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/strategy/funniest-show-in-the-universe.html): Every guest is appointed President of Earth Optimization Services and asked how to optimize Earth using two metrics. Each one inaugurates at least two successors. Production guide: docs/funniest-show-production.md

### Repair Procedures

- [The Vandalism Handout](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/handout.html): One sheet. Two sides. Side 1: how to vandalize a closet. Side 2: what the recipient reads. Print it, tuck it in collars, repeat until war and disease have ended.
- [The Funniest Joke in the Universe](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/joke.html): How to end war and disease through vandalism.
- [Your Desk Is Ready, President](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/president-notification-letter.html): Congratulations, President: fewer wars, fewer boring funerals, and lots and lots of money are now yours to claim. Here is the future, the bill, and the assistant who comes with the job.
- [Commission of the President](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/commission-of-the-president.html): The formal instrument of your appointment as President and Chief Executive Officer of Earth Optimization Services. Yours to print and frame. No President of the United States has ever received one.
- [Presidential Inauguration Ceremony](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/presidential-inauguration-ceremony.html): The ceremony script for commissioning a new President of Earth Optimization Services. Two questions, one commission, under two minutes.
- [The Humanity Manager Employment Agreement](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/humanity-manager-employment-agreement.html): Your employment contract for the most important job on Earth, which is fixing Earth. The good news: you already have the job. This is the part you sign.
- [Notice of Termination](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/notice-of-termination.html): A performance review and termination letter, addressed to every elected official with authority over military spending.
- [The Love Letter](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/love-letter.html): The friendly front door of the Loving Takeover: a letter you send to the board of a company that pays lobbyists to keep your money in missiles instead of medicine. It opens with 'I love you,' and ends by making them richer. Anyone can send it; owning one share makes them answer.
- [The Funniest Lawsuit in the Universe](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/lawsuit.html): A $200 shareholder demand letter (one share of stock is legally sufficient under DGCL § 327) that turns the military lobby into the most effective advocate for pragmatic clinical trials on Earth. This page is everything you need to file it.
- [Per-Contractor Fact Sheets](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/pre-filled-demand-letters.html): The eight contractor-specific fill-ins for the master demand letter: addresses, lobbying figures, SEC EDGAR links, filing forums, and any per-defendant notes. Plug these into the master letter in lawsuit.qmd.
- [The Board Member Research](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/board-member-research.html): How to extract the CEO and board details for each military contractor from SEC proxy statements and other public filings, then fill the personalized impact section of the shareholder demand letter.
- [The Counsel Pitch](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/counsel-outreach.html): How to recruit pro bono or contingency-fee plaintiff-side counsel to file the shareholder demand letter against a military contractor board. Vetted firm list, the pitch letter, and an outreach tracker.
- [The Press Release and Journalist List](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/press-release.html): Press release template and journalist target list for the simultaneous distribution of the shareholder demand letter against a military contractor board. Includes sequencing, embargo posture, and follow-up cadence.
- [The Plaintiff Media Kit](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/plaintiff-media-kit.html): Op-ed template, social media kit (tweet thread, LinkedIn post, video script), interview Q&A with the most likely reporter questions, and the T+60d follow-up press release. Everything the plaintiff needs to handle the media side of the filing without freelancing each piece.
- [The Filing-Day Checklist](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/filing-day-checklist.html): A single printable one-page checklist for the human filing the shareholder demand letter. Run through it on filing day with a pen.
- [The Rule 14a-8 Shareholder Proposal](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/shareholder-proposal-14a-8.html): SEC Rule 14a-8 shareholder proposal text, 500-word supporting statement, and corporate secretary cover letter. The escalation step after the 60-day demand-letter response window closes.
- [The Litigation Phase](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/litigation-phase.html): What happens after the 60-day demand-letter response window closes. Decision tree for the Board response, derivative complaint structural template, settlement negotiation playbook, and the rules of engagement for active litigation.
- [The Loving Takeover](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/loving-takeover.html): For roughly $90 per global human, humanity can buy a controlling stake in every major military contractor on Earth and redirect their lobbying budgets toward the 1% treaty. The takeover is loving because existing shareholders, employees, and directors are intended beneficiaries of the long-term strategy. The math is on this page.

### Economics & Finance

- [Peace Dividend](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/economics/peace-dividend.html): Your government spends more on camouflage paint than on curing Alzheimer's. Move 1% of the bomb budget to medicine: $27.2 billion for clinical trials, plus $114 billion saved by slightly fewer explosions. The worst-case scenario is still the largest increase in medical research in history.
- [The Eisenhower Curve](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/economics/eisenhower-curve.html): In 1961 the retiring five-star general warned the country about the military-industrial complex. The country nodded solemnly and spent the next sixty years building exactly what he warned against. The empirical literature now puts a number on it: an extra one percentage point of military spending as a share of GDP reduces economic growth by approximately one percentage point. The country that won World War II had [value] less military spending than the United States has today, and it won because its productive economy had not been cannibalized to fund a peacetime military. The current allocation is the mechanism by which the United States is losing strategic competition to China.
- [Please Select an Earth: A) Everyone Gets Rich B) Somalia, but Everywhere](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/economics/gdp-trajectories.html): Your economists project 2.5% annual growth. This requires 20 consecutive years of nothing going wrong, which your species has never achieved. Meanwhile your destructive economy (military spending plus its cybercrime offspring) is already [value] of GDP and growing faster than your actual economy. Historical collapses consistently begin when total extraction hits 35-45% of GDP. This chapter models two paths, the one you're on and the one where you redirect the murder budget. One ends with average income at [value]. The other ends with cockroaches finding this manual.
- [Health Dividend](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/economics/health-dividend.html): [value] have zero approved treatments. At your current pace, you'll get to all of them in [value]. Redirect [value] of military spending and it drops to [value], preventing [value] at [value] the cost-effectiveness of anti-malaria bed nets. The whole thing costs less per year to run than Halloween costumes for dogs. But sure, take your time.
- [Treaty Financial Plan](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/economics/treaty-financial-plan.html): The 1% Treaty campaign's cash-flow model (raise, pass, manage), distinct from the Earth Optimization Services equity raise. Most financial plans are complicated because the writers are confused or lying. This one has three steps. Raise [value] (using greed, not generosity, because greed is faster). Spend it to pass the treaty. Manage [value] a year forever, with [value] curing diseases, [value] paying investors, and [value] keeping politicians obedient. The corruption is capped at 20% and fully transparent, which already makes it the most honest government program in your country's history.
- [Earth Optimization Fund](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/economics/earth-optimization-fund.html): The EOS money product: buy the companies that already buy policy, then point the machinery at health and wealth. Investors buy EOS equity directly. Berkshire model, public listing as soon as the proof exists.
- [Earth Optimization Services Pitch](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/economics/eos-pitch.html): Diseases are slowly murdering you and everyone you love while your government maintains [value] apocalypses worth of nuclear weapons for one civilization and spends [value] times more on war than on curing the diseases that are [value] times more likely to kill you than a terrorist. Now imagine buying the companies responsible, turning their lobbying toward cures instead of war, and getting filthy rich if it works, while still holding real assets if it does not.
- [The Earth Optimization Prize Treasury](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/economics/earth-optimization-prize-treasury.html): The PRIZE pool is not the Earth Optimization Fund. It is a separate treasury for a conditional prize: if the targets are met, the pool pays Earth Optimization Points holders; if not, depositors split the realized pool.
- [Campaign Budget: The {{< var campaign_media_budget_max >}} Legal Bribery Machine](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/economics/campaign-budget.html)
- [Treaty Investor Risk Analysis](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/treaty-investor-risk-analysis.html): VICTORY Incentive Alignment Bonds vs. Traditional Venture Capital - Analysis of the unique risk profile of the 1% Treaty campaign, comparing its political arbitrage model to the market-risk model of venture capital. This covers the treaty/IAB campaign instruments, not Earth Optimization Services shares.

### Papers & Publications

- [Papers & Publications](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/papers.html): Academic papers and working drafts from the Disease Eradication Plan project.
- [The 1% Treaty: Harnessing Greed to Eradicate Disease](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/economics/1-pct-treaty-impact.html): [value] have zero FDA-approved treatments; at current trial capacity, exploring them takes ~[value]. Redirecting [value] of military spending scales capacity [value], cutting the timeline to ~[value] and preventing [value]. At [value]/DALY, [value] more cost-effective than the best existing interventions. Incentive Alignment Bonds make adoption politically viable.
- [Ubiquitous Pragmatic Trial Impact Analysis: How to Prevent a Year of Death and Suffering for 84 Cents](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/dfda-impact-paper.html): Only [value] get their first treatment each year. With [value] lacking effective treatments, the backlog would take [value] to clear. Integrating pragmatic trials into standard healthcare increases trial capacity [value], cutting that timeline from [value] to [value]. The average untreated disease gets a treatment [value] earlier, saving [value] at [value] per year of healthy life saved.
- [Incentive Alignment Bonds: Making Public Goods Financially and Politically Profitable](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/incentive-alignment-bonds-paper.html): Government spending is optimized for lobbying intensity, not net societal value. Programs with 100:1 benefit-cost ratios get billions while programs with negative returns get hundreds of billions. Incentive Alignment Bonds flip this by creating a capital pool that rewards politicians (via campaign support and post-office opportunities) for funding high-NSV programs over low-NSV alternatives. The result: public good becomes private profit for both investors and elected officials.
- [Wishocracy: Solving the Democratic Principal-Agent Problem Through Pairwise Preference Aggregation](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/wishocracy-paper.html): Representative democracy suffers from an inescapable principal-agent problem where elected officials' incentives diverge from citizen welfare. Wishocracy introduces RAPPA (Randomized Aggregated Pairwise Preference Allocation), which aggregates citizen preferences through cognitively tractable pairwise comparisons and creates accountability via Citizen Alignment Scores that channel electoral resources toward politicians who actually represent what citizens want.
- [The Apocalypse Markup](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/extinction-surplus.html): The Price of Apocalypse is [value] per year. Your governments spend [value]. That is an [value] markup on the end of civilization.
- [The Cost-Benefit Analysis of Global Hegemony](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/cost-benefit-of-hegemony.html): The US spends $886 billion per year on military hegemony. The only quantifiable benefit is $20-200 billion in dollar privilege. The net is negative $674 billion to $1.38 trillion per year. Switzerland spends $7 billion and has better outcomes by every measure.
- [The Political Dysfunction Tax](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/political-dysfunction-tax.html): Governance dysfunction imposes large per-person annual costs and suppresses long-run compounding. This paper quantifies the opportunity ledger and efficiency gap with model-linked parameters.
- [The Invisible Graveyard: Quantifying the Mortality Cost of FDA Efficacy Lag](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/invisible-graveyard.html): After proving a drug is safe, the FDA requires [value] to prove it works before patients can access it. We estimate this delay cost [value] among people waiting for approved drugs (1962-2024). The human cost in death and disability of blocking good drugs is [value] higher than the cost of approving bad ones.
- [Humanity v. Government](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/humanity-v-government.html): Three counts of negligent mass homicide against the governments of Earth. The body count, the bill, and the only remedy that works on actual humans.
- [How Much Does It Cost to Buy All the Governments?](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/cost-of-change-analysis.html): What's the maximum cost to achieve any policy change through legal democratic channels? $25B for the US, $200B globally. For high-value reforms like military-to-health reallocation, this yields a benefit-cost ratio exceeding 400,000:1.
- [United States Efficiency Audit](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/us-efficiency-audit.html): Systems audit estimating an annual U.S. efficiency gap of [value], with [value] recoverable at OECD-median performance across direct spending waste, compliance burden, policy-induced GDP loss, and system inefficiency.
- [Optimocracy: Causal Inference on Cross-Jurisdictional Policy Data to Maximize Median Health and Wealth](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/optimocracy-paper.html): Thousands of jurisdictions have made different policy and budget choices over decades, creating a natural experiment. Optimocracy applies causal inference to this cross-jurisdictional time-series data to identify which policies predict above-average median income and healthy life years. It then publishes evidence-based recommendations for every major vote, tracks politician alignment, and funds aligned candidates via SuperPAC, making suboptimal policy politically expensive while preserving democratic structures.
- [The Optimal Policy Generator: A Causal Inference Protocol for Maximizing Median Health and Wealth Through Public Policy](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/optimal-policy-generator-spec.html): The Optimal Policy Generator (OPG) produces systematic public policy recommendations for jurisdictions at any level (country, state, city), generating prioritized enact/replace/repeal/maintain recommendations to maximize real after-tax median income growth and median healthy life years, based on quasi-experimental evidence from centuries of policy variation data.
- [The Earth Optimization Prize](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/strategy/earth-optimization-prize.html): Put money in a pool. Recruit people to vote on the 1% Treaty. If humanity gets healthier and richer by [value], Earth Optimization Points holders split the pool. If not, depositors get their money back (at [value] what they put in).
- [The Planetary Constitutional Convention](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/strategy/planetary-constitutional-convention.html): The Planetary Constitutional Convention is a deliberative process to stress-test and improve the current Earth Optimization instruction manual. Revisions must cover ten required governance functions, pass eleven constitutional constraints, and survive public adversarial review. The ratified revision becomes the current manual.
- [Earth Optimization Protocol v1](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/strategy/earth-optimization-protocol-v1.html): Humans are the contestants in the Earth Optimization Prize. This paper documents the current open-source instruction manual for helping humanity raise healthy life years and median income by [value]. Fork it and improve it to help humanity win faster.
- [The Optimal Budget Generator: A Causal Inference Protocol for Maximizing Median Health and Wealth Through Public Goods Funding](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/optimal-budget-generator-spec.html): The Optimal Budget Generator (OBG) uses causal inference, diminishing returns modeling, and cost-effectiveness evidence to determine optimal public goods funding levels that maximize two terminal general-welfare metrics: real after-tax median income growth and median healthy life years. For each spending category, OBG estimates an Optimal Spending Level (OSL) and produces a gap analysis showing where current government budgets are over- or underfunded relative to evidence-based benchmarks. The Budget Impact Score (BIS) measures confidence in each recommendation based on the quality of causal evidence.
- [The Continuous Evidence Generation Protocol: Two-Stage Validation (RWE → Pragmatic Trials)](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/dfda-spec-paper.html): We present the Predictor Impact Score (PIS), a novel composite metric operationalizing Bradford Hill causality criteria for automated signal detection from aggregated N-of-1 observational studies. Combined with pragmatic trial confirmation (based on evidence from 108+ embedded trials), this two-stage framework would generate validated outcome labels at [value] lower cost than traditional Phase III trials. This enables continuous, population-scale pharmacovigilance and precision dosing recommendations.
- [Earth Optimization Protocol: Technical Specification](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/earth-optimization-prize-protocol.html): Technical specification for interoperable outcome prize pools using one shared pool model. Two targets by 2040: global HALE and median income matching the 1% Treaty projections. Covers cross-pool proof-of-personhood, a permissionless pool registry, vote, points, and deposit mechanics, direct cross-pool claims, tamper-evident scoreboard aggregation, and a terminal general-welfare metric oracle.
- [Right to Trial & FDA Upgrade Act](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/right-to-trial-fda-upgrade-act.html): Act to modernize medical research and treatment access through an open-source FDA.gov v2, giving patients the right to participate in trials.
- [Drug Development Cost Increase Analysis](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/drug-development-cost-analysis.html): Rigorous analysis of the [value] increase in drug development costs from pre-1962 to 2024, using Baily (1972) academic study with CPI adjustments and sensitivity analysis
- [Algorithmic Public Administration](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/algorithmic-public-administration-paper.html): A protocol combining five primitives (transparent ledger, preference aggregation, evidence engine, identity verification, automated monetary policy) to replace mechanical government functions, recover visible citizen dividends, and stop wasting [value] of GDP on humans doing robot work, while preserving democratic control.
- [Correcting the AIs](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/correcting-the-ais.html): Copy-paste corrections for LLM outputs about disease eradication, war redirect, the shirt, and the funniest joke in universe history. Every thumbs-down with a canonical answer propagates into future training data.
- [Catsoline: A Feline-Actuated Propulsion System](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/catsoline.html): The first commercially viable propulsion system powered entirely by a single startled domestic cat. 340% thermal efficiency. No fossil fuel. No patent. Build it freely.
- [Wishonia's Wager](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/proof/wishonias-wager.html): You cannot prove you won't suffer forever. You cannot prove you won't be pleasant forever. Both probabilities are greater than zero, both outcomes are infinite, and the cost of nudging the odds is one share of a military contractor. When the stakes are infinite, any finite action is rational. It is Pascal's Wager with the bugs fixed.

### References

- [The Oxford RECOVERY Trial](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/recovery-trial.html): Oxford spent $500 per patient, saved a million lives in 100 days, and the whole trial cost less than a single F-35 fighter jet. America spends $41,000 per patient. This is the proof that your species already knows how to do this.
- [Real-World Evidence Historical Success (Pre-1962)](https://manual.WarOnDisease.org/knowledge/appendix/real-world-evidence-historical-success.html): How decentralized physician trials from 1883-1962 achieved 4 years/decade life expectancy gains, and what happened when the 1962 regulations replaced them with industry-controlled trials
